hvac.description: Complete removal and replacement of all HVAC systems in Building 1791
hvac.quote: This project includes the entire removal of the HVAC systems in Building 1791.
systems: AHU-1: 100% outside air unit with chilled water cooler and gas heating serving welding room; includes dust collector with recirculation and explosion-proof VFD
AHU-2: Constant volume with energy recovery wheel, chilled water coil, gas heat
AHU-3: Constant volume with energy recovery wheel, chilled water coil, gas heat
AHU-4: Constant volume with energy recovery wheel, chilled water coil, gas heat
AHU-5: Constant volume with energy recovery wheel, chilled water coil, gas heat
AHU-6: Split system cooling only for Communications and Electrical rooms
Paint booth: Specialized AHU with VFD on supply and exhaust fans
Two chillers: one for main building AHUs (with buffer tank, 30% glycol, expansion tank), one for paint booth AHU (with buffer tank)
Electric unit heaters in Riser room, Mechanical room, Communications room, Electrical room
Central dust/fume collector for welding shop with 6-inch point-of-use extractors and VFD
Dirty/Sanding Room ventilation system for airborne aluminum, steel, titanium, polyurethane paint, epoxy primer, etc.

electrical.description: Complete replacement of electrical service including pad-mounted transformers, primary switch, and all associated wiring
electrical.quote: modify incoming electrical service by demolition and replacement of the existing pad-mounted transformers, primary switch, and all associated wiring and materials.
systems: 1.5 MVA transformer rated at 13,200-480Y/277V
1,600A 480/277V service rated Switchboard
225 KVA step-down transformer, 480V:120/240V
150 KVA step-down transformer, 480V:120/208V
480/277V, 208/120V, and 240/120V panelboards
LED lighting throughout per ASHRAE 90.1 and UFC 3-530-01 with occupancy sensors
SPDs (surge protection devices) throughout
Dedicated circuits for motorized roll-up doors
Arc flash hazard analysis study per NFPA 70E

plumbing.description: Complete new domestic water, sanitary, gas, and compressed air systems
plumbing.quote: Provide hot and cold domestic water supply to fixtures; sanitary waste, vent and drainage systems. Provide compressed air system and trench drains for service shop.

Sanitary waste/vent/drain (schedule 40 PVC below floor; cast iron no-hub above floor)
2 natural gas-fired instantaneous (tankless) water heaters mounted outdoors
Compressed air system: duplex rotary-screw compressors with 18 service bays + 3 tire-changing machines + tool room
2 low-pressure breathing air compressors (5 cfm min each, 2x 3M face masks)
Emergency eyewash/shower station
Natural gas piping (black carbon steel, schedule 40)

Paint booth sprinkler with isolation valve (extra hazard design per NFPA 33)
New Post Indicator Valve at 40 feet from building
Fire department connection

environmental_hazmat.scope: Hazardous materials investigation and abatement as part of renovation
environmental_hazmat.quote: The scope of work included: (1) identifying, collecting and analyzing bulk samples of suspect asbestos-containing materials (ACM), (2) identifying, collecting and analyzing samples of existing paint to determine lead, cadmium and chromium concentrations, (3) inspecting a percentage of existing fluorescent light fixtures for the presence of Polychlorinated Biphenyl (PCB) light ballasts and light tubes containing mercury vapor and (4) performing a visual inspection for other mercury and PCB containing components.

PCB-containing fluorescent ballasts (assumed unless labeled 'No PCBs')
Two PCB-rated electrical transformers (<1 ppm PCB)
Lead-lined walls and doors in former x-ray room

The Fire Alarm section provides more precise engineering data. Difference of 61 SF (~0.3%) is minor and likely attributable to gross vs. net measurement or rounding in the Architectural section.
